text: I am selling a $10M luxury residential property in Perth. Which prestige real estate agencies have the strongest track record for high-end home sales?

result.keyword: I am selling a $10M luxury residential property in Perth. Which prestige real estate agencies have the strongest track record for high-end home sales?

items.markdown:
For a $10M luxury listing in Perth, the agencies with the most dominant track records for ultra-high-end residential transactions are clustered across Perth's western suburbs. The premier groups handling properties at this price point include `Ray White Dalkeith | Claremont | Fremantle` (led by top-ranked agents like Vivien Yap), William Porteous Properties International, [ACTON | Belle Property Cottesloe](https://reiwa.com.au/real-estate-agents/dalkeith/) , and specialized high-end independent luxury teams.

### Top Agencies & Teams for $10M+ Sales

- Ray White Dalkeith | Claremont | Fremantle — Consistently ranks at the absolute peak of WA settled commission and high-value transactions, leveraging extensive international and domestic buyer networks.[[1]](https://www.raywhite.com/vivien-yap/real-estate-agent/vy172214065)[[2]](https://raywhitedalkeithclaremontfremantle.com.au/agents/vivien-yap/101920)
- William Porteous Properties International — Deeply embedded in Perth’s historic luxury enclaves like Dalkeith, Mosman Park, and Peppermint Grove for decades, specializing in unique trophy estates.[[1]](https://reiwa.com.au/real-estate-agents/dalkeith/)
- [ACTON | Belle Property Cottesloe](https://reiwa.com.au/real-estate-agents/dalkeith/) — Highly active across coastal luxury corridors (Cottesloe, Swanbourne, and Dalkeith) with a proven upper-bracket median sale record.[[1]](https://reiwa.com.au/real-estate-agents/dalkeith/)
- **The Agency Perth** — Features high-performing individual prestige property specialists with major multi-million dollar sales volumes across metro and riverside suburbs.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdac01IbDZOWGwyGAo)

### Key Factors to Consider for a $10M Property

- **Buyer Database:** Ensure the agency has a confidential, active database of high-net-worth local, interstate, and international (particularly Southeast Asian) buyers.
- **Marketing Reach:** High-end homes at this tier require bespoke global syndication (such as Christie's or Sotheby's networks, or high-tier national exposure) rather than standard local advertising.
- **Negotiation Track Record:** Look for principal-level agents who personally manage negotiations for ultra-prime property rather than handing them off to junior associates.[[1]](https://www.raywhite.com/vivien-yap/real-estate-agent/vy172214065)

If you would like, share the **specific suburb** and **style of the property** (e.g., modern riverfront, heritage coastal estate) so I can help point you toward the **individual lead agent** with the highest concentration of record sales in that exact micro-market.
